name: Grouper
siboNotes: Plain grouper is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Focus on simple preparation methods to avoid triggering ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with low FODMAP herbs like basil, oregano, or chives
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Grill, bake, or pan-sear with olive oil and lemon
Avoid breading with wheat flour - use rice flour or cornmeal instead
